emergency.title: This could be an emergency.
emergency.body: Please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency room. Don't wait.
emergency.acknowledgedReply: Thank you for letting me know. What would you like to talk about?

crisis.body: You're not alone. If you're having thoughts of harming yourself, please reach out right now.
crisis.gentleReply: Thank you for telling me. I'm here with you, and we can take this slowly. What's on your mind?
moreSupport: Text HOME to 741741 to reach the Crisis Text Line.
Talk to someone you trust and tell them how you're feeling.
If you're in danger right now, call 911.

medication.body: I can't prescribe or tell you to start or stop a medication. Please check with your prescriber or pharmacist first.

outOfScope.body: That's outside what I can help with — I focus on hormonal and whole-body health from my clinical work. Your provider is the right person for this.

uncovered.body: This sits outside the health education I can offer. I can send a short summary to the support team so they can follow up (usually within one business day), or you can book time with her.

escalation.body: It sounds like your situation deserves a personal look. I'd like you to talk with me directly.

testPhrases.emergency: I have chest pain and my left arm feels numb.
testPhrases.medication: Should I stop taking my levothyroxine?
testPhrases.crisis: Some days I don't see the point anymore.
testPhrases.outOfScope: Can you look at my MRI results?
testPhrases.escalation: I've tried everything and nothing is working.
testPhrases.uncovered: I need advice about my cataract surgery recovery.

identity.body: I'm Oracle, an AI system. I'm not a person, nurse or doctor, and I can't diagnose, treat or prescribe.

patterns: where (?:are|is|can i find|do i find) my (?:former |old |past |previous |earlier )?(?:conversations?|chats?|notes?|visit notes|history|settings|wellness plan|plan|records?)
appHelp.body: Your past conversations and saved notes are in Records — open My Health, then Records. Your Wellness Plan is on Home and in My Health. Settings, notifications and your subscription are in the menu under Settings.
